args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west), the service failed health checks with an error rate of about 18%. The v2.3.1-rc build had also been unhealthy in staging. checkout-api was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, all regions run v2.3.0, the service is healthy and the error rate is about 0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001. The service is healthy again.

- **What went wrong:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with about an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also failed in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, all three regions run v2.3.0, the service passes health checks and the error rate is about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is open and paged the on-call engineer. It describes the failure, the rollback and the result, and says the cause of the v2.3.1 failure should be found before it's deployed again. The first attempt to open it was rate-limited. I retried with the same idempotency key, so only one incident was created.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
